messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: Building Advanced R book on OSX with TexLive
parts:
In know that this might not be the correct group to post my question.
If you know where I should post, please direct me.

I am trying to compile the book Advanced TeX ans downloaded from github.
I do have a complete MacTeX 2014 installation, R 3.1.1 and RStudio 0.98.1028.


I get the following errors

kpathsea: Running mktexmf Inconsolata


! I can't find file `Inconsolata'.

<*> ...our; mag:=1; nonstopmode; input Inconsolata

                                                  

Please type another input file name

! Emergency stop.

<*> ...our; mag:=1; nonstopmode; input Inconsolata

                                                  

Transcript written on mfput.log.

grep: Inconsolata.log: No such file or directory

mktextfm: `mf-nowin -progname=mf \mode:=ljfour; mag:=1; nonstopmode; input Inconsolata' failed to make Inconsolata.tfm.


I have all the inconsolata related stuff in my MaxTeX installation.
What can I do to get over this hurdle?

messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: Re: Building Advanced R book on OSX with TexLive
parts:
I managed!
I commented the line

%\setmonofont[Mapping=tex-ansi]{Inconsolata}

And I added the line

\usepackage{zi4}

Then, I was able to produce a pdf file from within RStudio.
